reviews.title: Beautiful Case with Air Flow Restrictions
reviews.comment: Moved my existing system from the Thermaltake view 380 TG XL to this Thermaltake View 600 TG with no build issues. Everything fit as it should but there is one major flaw for a advertised "Air Flow" case. I am using a 360 mm AIO. That flaw is restricting flow by reducing the openings on both the top and back removable panels. The actual resulting fan area after mounting is reduced by approximately 25% for a 120 mm fan and it is even worse if you use 140mm fans. I do not know what Thermaltake was thinking when they developed these fan mounting brackets. I do have data I recorded on this exact system from my prior case and I will compare the two cases. There are no such restrictions on my view 380 XL. So I have a dilemma in that I love the case otherwise, but I do not like the air flow restrictions in this case. So I must deduct a full 2 stars because of this fact and hope that Thermaltake will have a retro-fix for this case.
reviews.author: Ray
